name: us033-refuse-bound-skip
description: 033 C6.3's third refusal state, RETIRED by 035. It captured a bound specification that no rank could place, refused with a message saying its project was 'fixed by its own markers' while acting on none of it. Since 035 the markers ARE acted on: the same fixture now resolves and exits 0. Kept as the cross-port proof that the state which used to refuse no longer does, identically on both ports.
